question: After the no-op pacing blocker is fixed, should OpenClaw keep unavailable-reconciler ambiguous outbound rows pending/recoverable instead of moving them to `failed/`?
rationale: The source-level blocker is mechanical, but the final behavior changes steady-state recovery and operator visibility for existing ambiguous delivery rows, which is a maintainer product choice.

options.title: Accept after pacing fix
options.body: Keep the PR's recoverable-pending behavior, but require the no-op deferral to skip replay pacing and require refreshed exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal `failed/` behavior until a broader delivery ledger can reconcile ambiguous rows.

options.title: Fold into the ledger design
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader delivery-state design under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87544 instead of landing a narrow queue-state change now.

recommendation.title: Accept after pacing fix
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's recoverable-pending behavior, but require the no-op deferral to skip replay pacing and require refreshed exact-head validation before merge.
